about: Companies known to employ people in India whose India hiring the job boards we read do not show (their board is read for Japan only, or their roles come from LinkedIn, Indeed or Japan Dev). fetch_japan.py finds the rest itself, from each company's open roles in India. Each entry says why, with a source; add one only with a source.
